Raj Patel: Hi team, starting Mon. Quick Q: can I use my personal Ubuntu 22.04 laptop for the first week? I have LUKS but Secure Boot off. Also phishsim Wed  will pending enrollment block me?

Maya (People Ops): Welcome Raj! :wave: Short answer: temporary BYOD ok with signed MOU. Secure Boot preferred but not mandatory if LUKS+agent escrow in place. Missing phishsim won't immediately revoke access, but please complete the remedial module if you fail.

IT-helpdesk: We need: `lsblk -f`, `uname -a`, and a LUKS header backup before we push agent. We'll run a quick 15-min walk-through. Secure Boot off is fine if you provide header backup.

Sam (Security): Policy: BYOD requires our management agent + DocuSign MOU. If TPM not used certs go into agent vault wrapped by KMS. Repeated phishsim failures escalate, single miss = coach + training.

Raj Patel: Thanks — pasted sanitized outputs: `uname -a`: Linux raj-dev 5.15.0-70-generic x86_64; `lsblk -f`: sda3 crypto_LUKS abcdef-...

Maya (People Ops): DocuSign sent. @onboarding-bot move Raj's "Security Quickstart" due date to Fri and open phishsim window. IT-helpdesk will DM walkthrough slot.

onboarding-bot: Training assigned: "Security Quickstart" due 2025-04-25. PhishSim window: 2025-04-22 -> 2025-04-29. Reminder set (2x).
